card.name: Repeated number or letter after a slash
card.fires_on: The word or digit that repeats something just seen earlier, such as the second half of a fraction or ratio like 60 of 63 or 18 mg/18 mg. It sits on the digit or letter that echoes an earlier one.

modes.label: Repeated digit in counts
modes.description: A digit inside a denominator or total that matches digits of the number seen earlier in the same sentence.

modes.label: Repeated dose amount
modes.description: A digit in the second half of a paired strength like 18 mg/18 mg.

modes.label: Repeated variable
modes.description: A letter or term repeated in a math expression or phrase.
modes.example: square root of x times square root of<< x>> equals x.
